title_en: Famous Restaurants (19/20): A Famous Dumpling Chain Expands
note_en: 必须 A，才能 B means "only if A can B": 必须每天新鲜现包，才能保证每一家分店的味道一样 "only by wrapping them fresh every day can every branch taste the same." Here 才 marks B as possible only under condition A, much like English "only... can," but Chinese puts the condition first and needs no inversion of subject and verb.
